summary: Jefferies Financial Group filed an SEC Form 424B5 pricing supplement for $7,467,000 aggregate principal amount of Senior Autocallable Contingent Coupon Barrier Notes due 2032. The notes are linked to the worst-performing of the Nasdaq-100, Russell 2000, and EURO STOXX 50 indices. The issue price is $1,000 per note. This is a routine structured note offering under a shelf registration, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other event-driven category applies. The filing represents ordinary debt issuance for funding purposes.
